mapper.sql: id, record_no, elder_id, elder_name, fee_type, fee_month, amount, paid_amount, status, due_date, pay_time, pay_method, create_by, create_time, update_time, remark
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fee_record ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fee_record WHERE elder_id = #{elderId} ORDER BY fee_month DESC, create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE fee_record SET paid_amount = paid_amount + #{payAmount}, status = CASE WHEN paid_amount + #{payAmount} >= amount THEN 'PAID' WHEN paid_amount + #{payAmount} > 0 THEN 'PARTIAL' ELSE 'UNPAID' END, pay_time = NOW(), pay_method = #{payMethod} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - paid_amount), 0) FROM fee_record WHERE amount > 0 AND status IN ('UNPAID', 'PARTIAL', 'OVERDUE')
AND fee_month = #{feeMonth}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(amount) - paid_amount), 0) FROM fee_record WHERE amount < 0 AND status IN ('UNREFUNDED', 'PARTIAL_REFUNDED')
AND fee_month = #{feeMonth}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT elder_id) FROM fee_record WHERE status IN ('UNPAID', 'PARTIAL', 'OVERDUE')
AND fee_month = #{feeMonth}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT elder_id) FROM fee_record WHERE amount < 0 AND status IN ('UNREFUNDED', 'PARTIAL_REFUNDED')
AND fee_month = #{feeMonth}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM fee_record WHERE fee_month = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) FROM fee_record WHERE fee_month = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')
